settings.question: How can I check the status of my order?
settings.answer:
Once the order is shipped from our warehouse, you will receive a tracking number and link via email and WhatsApp message. Please track your order with the tracking number and link provided.

Alternatively,

You can also use the following link to track your order:

https://baccabucci.clickpost.ai/

settings.question: How do I cancel my order?
settings.answer:

You can also reach us at :-

Phone: +91- 82877-31376 (Mon to Sat 10 am to 6 pm)

settings.question: How can I exchange & return my order?
settings.answer:
We offer our customers an "easy return and exchange policy," wherein you can raise a return or exchange request of a product within 7 days of its delivery.

We have a reverse pick-up facility for most PIN codes. Return products are picked up within 2-4 business days by our own courier.

We also accept partial returns, wherein you can raise a return request for one or all products in your order.

Please Browse through following Link to process you return or Exchange Request:-

https://baccabucci.clickpost.ai/return-exchange

Note 1: For PIN codes that are non-serviceable by our courier partners due to the reverse pick-up policy, you will have to self-ship the product(s) to the following address:

Note 2: Rs.49 will be deducted as refund processing charges.

Bacca Bucci Fashions Pvt Ltd.

G-152, Gazipur Village, East Delhi-110096

Landmark: Near MCD School of G-block

(Please ensure the items are packed securely to prevent any loss or damage during transit.)

Note 3: In the interest of hygiene, we may refuse returns where it's obvious that the item has been worn, washed, or soiled. Defective products need not be sent back to us unless confirmed by the Customer Experience Team. If you have received a defective product, send us images at crm@baccabucci.com and we will get back to you. Once confirmed by the Customer Experience Team, the refund will be provided to your bank account.

Note 4: Rejected goods must be claimed within 30 days from the date the rejection email is received. After this period, the company will not be responsible for unclaimed items.

Note 5: All pre-orders are final. Cancellation requests will not be accepted once the order is placed.

settings.question: How can I get my money back after the order is returned?
settings.answer:
Once the order is picked up by our courier partner and reaches us, our CRM will get it checked, and if the product is found in its original condition, a refund or exchange will be processed.

Please send us your bank account number and IFSC code at crm@baccabucci.com, mentioning your order number.

Note: Processing payments through the bank may take up to 3 to 4 working days.

Note: Rs.49 will be deducted as refund processing charges.

Please keep a record of your return shipment receipt and tracking number.

settings.question: How long will it take for my order to be delivered?
settings.answer:
We ship 95% of our orders through Bluedart Air; once the order is shipped, it typically takes 1-2 business days for major metros, 1-3 for state capitals, and 2-4 days for the rest of India. North Eastern States and region of Kashmir, it may take up to 4–7 business days to deliver your order.

Note: Depending on the shipping address and other variables (such as public holidays, severe weather, etc.), delivery time may change in certain cases.

Check the status of your order here:

https://baccabucci.clickpost.ai/

settings.question: How do I know if I placed my order successfully?
settings.answer:

You’ll receive another email and SMS/WhatsApp once your order is shipped out. All you have to do then is sit back, relax, and wait for your awesome product(s) to arrive!

You can also use the following link to track your order:

https://baccabucci.clickpost.ai/
